statement: Paper B Lemma 4.4, the small-shift nested sum, with an explicit constant. Let X(n) = n^{3/2}, Y(n) = floor(X(n))^{3/2} and Delta_h f(n) = f(n+2h) - f(n). For every real C, all P >= 1, integers 1 <= h <= P^{1/12} and integers i, j, k with j != 0 and |i|, |j|, |k| <= C P^{1/24}, the sum of e((i/2) Delta_h X + (j/2) Delta_h Y + (k/2) Delta_h(n^{9/8})) over the odd n with P < n <= 2P - 2h has modulus at most K P^{7/8}(1 + h^{1/2}), where K = 3 (4096 C')^3 + 508000 C' + 1 and C' = max(C, 1). The proof conjugates negative j, passes to the retained phase at cost (4.6), freezes the carry on level sets of floor(Delta_h X) where the phase has curvature of size u h P^{-3/4}, expands the two sawtooths of (4.8) by Lemma 4.3 with R = floor(P^{1/4}), bounds each mode by its own curvature |r| P^{-1/2}, and bounds the near-integer sums by (4.3). For P < (4096 C')^{24} it is the trivial bound.
